data.title: 圣路易斯 · 跑车副驾的落日兜风
data.description: 沿海观光公路在落日余晖中泛起金红流光。圣路易斯单手握着跑车方向盘，侧头向副驾的你轻眨蓝眸，水蓝单马尾随海风飞舞，唇下美人痣满是撩人的笑意。
data.location: open-top convertible driving along coastal highway at sunset
data.action: sitting in luxury sports car passenger seat, sunglasses pushed up, looking over at driver with affectionate wink, golden hour ocean highway
data.lighting: radiant golden hour sun reflecting on car chrome and sea waves
data.mood: luxurious romantic freedom, heart-fluttering cool girlfriend, coastal breeze
data.promptProse: Driving an open-top sports car along the ocean road at sunset, St. Louis winks affectionately with sunglasses pushed into her blue hair.
